description_en: Creates a smart contract project within a consortium
description_zh: 在联盟内创建一个合约工程
kebab_example: aliyun baas create-ant-chain-contract-project --consortium-id DV80nJXq --project-name projectname --project-version v1.0.0 --project-description project_description --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAntChainContractProject

parameters.description_en: The project name. The name can contain letters, digits, common Chinese characters, and hyphens (-). The name cannot contain periods, spaces, or other special characters. The name must be 1 to 30 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh: 项目名称，只能由英文大小写、数字、常用汉字和短划线（-）的自由组合，不能有小数点、空格等特殊字符，限制在1~30个字符。
